easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
